scripts.dev: npm run prisma:generate && npm run check:src-no-js && DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=.env.local tsx watch src/index.ts
scripts.build:client: if [ -f ../client/package-lock.json ]; then npm --prefix ../client ci && npm --prefix ../client run build && rm -rf public && mkdir -p public && cp -R ../client/dist/. public/; else echo 'Skipping client build: ../client not present in build context'; fi
scripts.build: npm run build:client && npm run check:src-no-js && npm run typecheck && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.test: npm run check:src-no-js && DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=.env.local NODE_ENV=test node -r dotenv/config ./node_modules/.bin/jest --runInBand
scripts.test:db: npm run check:src-no-js && DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=.env.local RUN_DB_TESTS=1 NODE_ENV=test node -r dotenv/config ./node_modules/.bin/jest --runInBand
scripts.test:ci: npm run check:src-no-js && DOTENV_CONFIG_PATH=.env.local NODE_ENV=test node -r dotenv/config ./node_modules/.bin/jest --runInBand --coverage
